blocks.text: Modern Periodic Law yeh kehta hai:

blocks.title: Modern Periodic Law
blocks.text: Elements ki physical aur chemical properties un ke atomic numbers ke periodic functions hain, yani atomic number barhne ke saath properties ek khaas waqfe ke baad dobara aati hain.

Atomic number atom mein protons ki tadaad hai. Yeh law periodic table ki “cornerstone” (buniyadi patthar) hai: milti-julti properties wale elements ek khaas waqfe ke baad dobara aate hain. Maslan jab elements ko barhte atomic number se rakha jaye to sodium, potassium aur cesium ki bohat si physical aur chemical properties lithium jaisi hoti hain, kyun ke yeh sab ek hi group mein hain. Lekin nucleus mein protons aahista aahista barhte hain aur naye electron shells jurte hain, is liye ek group aur ek period ke andar properties ek tarteeb (system) se badalti hain.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Agle topics in properties ko ek ek kar ke dekhte hain: atomic radius, ionic radius, ionization energy, electron affinity, electronegativity aur metallic character. Har ek ke liye do sawal yaad rakhein: period mein baen se daen kya hota hai, aur group mein oopar se neeche kya hota hai.

blocks.prompt: Sodium, potassium aur cesium lithium jaise kyun hain, phir bhi un ki properties mein farq kyun hai?
blocks.explanation: Yeh lithium jaise is liye hain ke sab ek hi group mein hain aur sab ka ek hi valence electron hai. Farq is liye hai ke har agle element mein zyada protons aur ek izafi (extra) shell hai, is liye size, ionization energy aur reactivity jaisi properties group mein neeche ek tarteeb se badalti hain.

items: Modern Periodic Law: properties atomic number ke periodic functions hain; milti-julti properties wale elements ek group mein dobara aate hain.
